primarySource.paraphrase: Single-selection tree re-entry should target the selected node; focus and selection remain separate. Typeahead is recommended. Dynamic/virtualized nodes require truthful hierarchy positions.

findings.classification: static source-supported followup; no current browser reproduction
findings.trigger: Open a reference detail, activate Files again, then Tab into the tree. WorkspaceFiles restores selectedPath and expands its real group, but fresh FileTree effect chooses activeElement or items[0], never selectedPath/aria-selected. The selected leaf can remain visually selected while the only tabstop is the first folder.
evidence: file-tree.tsx useEffect selects document.activeElement or first visible item, deps expandedPaths/children
WorkspacePanels.tsx switches panel branches and passes layout.selectedPath to newly mounted WorkspaceFiles
panels.tsx initial expansion honors selected reference kind; it does not own focus restoration
findings.candidate: Keep current roving-tabstop ownership. Prefer already focused visible item; otherwise resolve the selected visible node by exact data-path or aria-selected, falling back to a visible ancestor/first item. Do not automatically focus on every background update and do not trigger selection/onOpen while choosing tabstop.
findings.verification: Browser case: open second or later reference, return Files, Tab reaches that selected leaf with one tabstop and unchanged detail-read count; missing/hidden selected leaf falls back safely; arrow navigation changes focus without detail fetch. Check pointer selected folder, group remount, task/connection swap, keyboard activation and both themes.

findings.classification: future composable interaction acceptance, not evidence current shipped plugin failure
findings.observation: The adapted composable tree exports FileTreeActions with event stopPropagation; generic printable-key typeahead is absent. Built-in task references currently use six fixed groups and ordinary leaves, so a large arbitrary filesystem is not established by this UI.
findings.candidate: If adding actions/search for long real reference sets, preserve nested action keyboard semantics and bound typeahead to visible names; ignore modifier/composition/editable descendants and do not load details on focus. Avoid installing a new tree framework or conflating reference IDs with filesystem paths.
findings.verification: A contributed action receives Enter/Space without triggering parent selection; printable search only moves focus; labels are literal text; no eager read, no new arbitrary-path API.
